tasks.label: Open Dev Container Shell (Auto-detect)
tasks.command: CONTAINER=$(docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' --filter 'name=vsc-' | head -1); if [ -z "$CONTAINER" ]; then echo 'No dev container found'; exit 1; fi; docker exec -it "$CONTAINER" /bin/zsh || docker exec -it "$CONTAINER" /bin/bash || docker exec -it "$CONTAINER" /bin/sh
